summary: Weakest area: Reel hooks fail (77% 3-sec drop) and zero DMs; bio violates rules (niche, region, timeframe, free offer).
guidance:
- Rotate hook: try contrast or comparison next (avoid top3/question; top3 used 3× recently, question underperforms on Instagram)
- Avoid listicle "3 things" phrasing; use specific pain-point or before/after contrast
- Keep posts as developer showing real work: share a code snippet, design decision, or client-agnostic insight, never promotional language
- For website posts: offer free quick look with 3 fixes only in DM, pay after approval

instructions.research: List 5 common website gaps for Indian small businesses (missing contact, slow load, no CTA, non-mobile, no trust signals) without niche focus.
instructions.analysis: Compare Oct 24 (top3) vs Oct 31 (comparison) website post engagement to confirm comparison works better.
instructions.writer: Write a comparison post: business with clear website vs only social bio, use cafe/gym/clinic example, end with DM for free 3-fix check or pay-after-approval.
instructions.image: Create split-screen graphic (desk-glow style) showing clean website layout vs cluttered social bio.
instructions.video: Skip video; produce a 3-slide carousel (bold-slow-reveal) for the same comparison.

manual_tips: Comment on 5 posts by Indian small business owners (cafes, gyms, clinics) about their online presence with genuine insights.
Update Instagram bio: remove niche list, region, '24 hrs', and free site check offer; keep only 'Websites for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM for free 3-fix check.'
Reply to any story mentions or tags from followers with helpful, non-promotional tips.
